visual_logic.color_palette: Slate-blue with a high-contrast white 'racing stripe' from eye to tail-fin.
visual_logic.environment: Deep indigo water with a hazy glow on the horizon and long, horizontal underwater sunbeams cutting straight across the wide frame to establish a clear tracking line.
visual_logic.action: Cruising horizontally just beneath the surface; splashing water is avoided to preserve clear visibility of the full length.

pose: A full-body horizontal profile view stretching completely from the left edge to the right edge of the frame. The massive 11-to-12-meter long body is aligned perfectly flat in the upper half of the image, keeping the bottom half clear so a second species can easily be drawn or stacked directly beneath it for side-by-side length comparison. Rather than arching its neck high out of the water, its long neck and tail extend out straight and horizontal along the tracking line to showcase its maximum scale.
